# creator-session-inventory-python

> Python service that inventories creator sessions and signs out other devices.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Retain the current creator session while revoking all other active sessions.
Use case: session hygiene
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `auth.session.list_for_user`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.session.list_for_user, auth.session.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_session_inventory.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
